comment: Definitely my favorite first semester professor. His genuine interest in the subject really rubs off on you. Everyone in my class appreciated that all he expected was that you do the readings and give your opinion. Definitely possible to get an A.
Kinsley is a great professor. His FYS was very interesting even though it was an 8 am class. He is a very nice guy and just helpful.

Class was not that challenging but it was a 8AM which made it terrible. There only about 3 grades and attendance is mandatory! Teaching style is basically straight from the text book so if you read before you end up just sitting there bored to tears
He doesn't teach, so it's hard to rate.  Classes are just class discussions led by classmates.  Waste of time, not worth the A.
Amusing, but arrogant. Neuro of relationships is interesting.
He is brilliant yet very down to earth with the students. always willing to talk and help anyone

It's a good class and you learn a lot.  He is clear and to the point, but sometimes goes over material too much so that it gets boring.  The tests are easy and very straightforward.  Another plus is that you don't want to have a lot of homework but still understand the concepts.
Amazing Professor who is one of the best known and respected in his field.  Also a very funny person.
This class will definately be easier if you have a biology background and you have a strong interest in neuro. Dr K is awesome.
Dr. K rules!  He loves his work, loves his students and loves neuroscience and psychology.  Plus he's hot in a dorky way.

Horrible! Class is nothing more than him reading the term definitions right out of the book. He is full of himself, and if he doesn't know the answer to a question, he makes it up. I learned absolutely nothing in his class - what a waste of time. On the plus side, his exams and assignments are easy.
